body.p: These pragmas configure the dynamic string heap. They must appear before the first dynamic string declaration and before the strings_dynamic library is included.

INDEX sets the width of the per-handle offset, length, and capacity fields and of the heap block headers. AUTO selects a width from the declared heap size, BYTE and WORD force one byte or two byte fields.
ALLOC selects the free-block search used by the allocator: FIRST_FIT takes the first block that is large enough, BEST_FIT takes the smallest block that fits.

RETRY controls the behavior after a failed allocation. With ON the allocator compacts the heap once and retries the search; with OFF the allocation fails immediately and the error is recorded in _string_error.
The heap size itself is not set by this pragma. Declare it with a WORD constant before the first dynamic string:
body.codeblock: CONST WORD _string_heap_size = 255 PRAGMA STRING INDEX BYTE INCLUDE strings_dynamic
body.note: The older PRAGMA STRING HEAP form is accepted but ignored: it neither sets the heap size nor produces a diagnostic. Use the _string_heap_size constant instead.
